Revenue left on the table

Free viewers leave with nothing to buy

Women who love the class but aren't ready for coaching have no small next step, so their intent fades before they are ready.

Time cost

When the next step is a call link, the curious and the committed book the same slots. Industry pattern: more no-shows and "just exploring" calls.

Growth ceiling

With no ads running, new sign-ups rise and fall with your content output. 1,920 posts in, organic is doing all of the work.

Your free class builds the trust. A small paid offer turns that trust into revenue that pays for ads, and shows you exactly who to talk to.

Script 1: "Ready soon"

Talking head, 30 to 45 seconds, filmed on your phone

Hook (0 to 3s)

"If your manager keeps saying you're 'ready soon', this is for you."

Body

"'Ready soon' usually means they can't see the case yet. Not that you're not good enough. In my live workshop I'll show you how to build a one-page promotion case and exactly what to say to open that conversation. It's 90 minutes, it's $27, and you get the replay and the templates."

Call to action

"Tap the link and grab your seat in the Promotion Playbook."

Shot note: close framing, natural light, on-screen caption of the hook for sound-off viewers.

Script 2: The promotion case

Talking head with on-screen template, 45 seconds

Hook (0 to 3s)

"This one page is what I wish every woman brought to her promotion conversation."

Body

"Your manager has to sell you to people you'll never meet. Make it easy for them: your wins, the impact in numbers, and the scope you're already covering. I'll walk you through filling this in live, and you keep the template."

Call to action

"Join the live workshop. Link below, $27."

Shot note: cut to a blurred mock of the template filling in as you talk.

Script 3: Interview stories

Talking head, 30 seconds

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Strong interview, no offer? It's usually the stories, not the experience."

Body

"Hiring managers remember stories, not lists. In the Promotion Playbook you get my interview answer bank: how to turn what you've done into answers people actually remember. Plus a live workshop to practise it."

Call to action

"Grab the Playbook for $27 at the link."

Shot note: text overlay "Lists vs stories" at the 5-second mark.
